slides.title: UN officials and ambassadors visit Mekelle, Tigray
slides.body: Two-day visit focuses on aid and displaced people

slides.text: Ethiopian outlet **Fana** (government-affiliated) reports a **two-day visit** that began **Nov 17** by **UN representatives and ambassadors**.
They were received at **Mekelle airport** by **Tigray Interim Administration** officials and plan to meet **religious leaders, elders and civil society**.
Fana lists **humanitarian aid** and **displaced people** on the agenda; Fidel Post says the UN pledged **faster aid delivery**.
**Protect civilians, choose dialogue.** Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Fana Media Corporation, Fidel Post, Nov 17, 2026
